body: Founder real-time: 'do a first pass generating weird items that expand the play space' -> 'using ffxi items and your own best judgement... and how they push the meta forward' -> 'add page 4 to the shop' -> explicit creative-latitude authorization ('if you cant be creative and want to block on founder direction thats fine but honestly i think you can handle it'). 6 new items using real FFXI names (docs/FFXI_ITEM_PARITY_SEED.md), matching the established Kraken Club/Ridill precedent. ARENA_ITEM_COUNT 27->33 -- apps/arena's own SHOP_PAGE_COUNT is entirely derived from this constant, so 'add page 4' needed zero new paging code. Two genuinely new mechanics: Gae Bolg (true/armor-piercing damage, applied after apply_armor -- this catalog's first stat that bypasses armor at all) and Masamune (lifesteal, this engine's first sustain mechanic). Balance Ring adds a dynamic comeback armor bonus computed live in arena_hero_armor() (scales with missing HP%), same 'computed live not cached' pattern the Zagan mirror/King Wealth aura already use. Muramasa/Empress Hairpin/Ninja Tekko round out the pass with stat-shape-only designs. 30 new test assertions, including 2 real test bugs found and fixed during verification (both in the tests, not production code): the default placeholder hero_id (Unicorn) carries real nonzero passive armor that silently threw off two tests' expected-value math; a mutual-combat interference bug where the un-equipped test target would counter-attack back within the same 2-tick window, contaminating the lifesteal measurement. Full test_arena.sh green (300+ assertions), clean build. REDGARDEN commit da1e58e.
title: Shop expansion: 6 new FFXI items (2 new mechanics), catalog reaches real shop page 4
